queries: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM patient_ratios), first_group AS (SELECT p.ratio, p.ratio - o.average_ratio AS above_overall FROM patient_ratios AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.average_ratio), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM first_group) SELECT AVG(f.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(f.above_overall) AS average_above_overall, AVG(f.ratio - s.average_ratio) AS average_above_second FROM first_group AS f CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE f.ratio > s.average_ratio
